incident-bot: Incident HIGH: Degraded API latency affecting generation endpoints detected 2026-03-14T18:45:21Z. Paging oncall.
elaine: Hey team — customer AcmePayments reported timeouts for several checkout flows. I'm drafting a post-incident follow-up for them. Can oncall confirm scope + mitigation timeline? cc @mike
mike: I'm on it. Quick summary: a bad autoscaling config + a slow model rollout caused increased queueing. We throttled rollout and scaled up dedicated pool at 18:47Z which brought latency back to SLO by ~18:55Z. Root cause investigation in progress.
sophia: Adding that the model variant we rolled had a different KV cache layout; on medium sequences it increased memory pressure causing GC spikes on some nodes.
elaine: Thanks. Acme asked for an immediate customer-facing note and whether there will be credits. Draft below — please edit. I want to send once we confirm timeline.
elaine: ```
Hi Acme team,

We saw elevated latency and timeouts for generation endpoints between ~18:45Z and ~18:55Z on 2026-03-14. The impact was caused by a model rollout interacting with autoscaling settings. We mitigated the issue by pausing the rollout and adding additional reserved capacity. We're continuing a full RCA and will follow up with technical details and preventative actions. As a gesture, we'd like to offer one day of service credit. Please let us know if you saw any unresolved issues.

Sincerely,
Elaine, Customer Success (Redwood Inference)
```
mike: Draft looks good. Couple edits: change times to exact: 18:45:21Z — 18:55:00Z. Also add that there was no customer data exposure. Add line: "No data exfiltration or compromise detected." jordan: I'll prod legal wording for the credit line.
sophia: For the technical follow-up, we'll include: timeline, root cause (KV cache layout + autoscale threshold interactions), mitigation (paused rollout + increased pool), and next steps (rollout checks + autoscale guardrails + preflight synthetic tests).
elaine: Can someone produce a short timeline blurb I can paste? Need bullet list under 5 lines.
mike: Paste this:

```
- 18:45:21Z: Model rollout triggered increased memory pressure on a subset of nodes.
- 18:46:10Z: Ops noticed elevated 95/99th latency and queueing. Pages sent to oncall.
- 18:47:05Z: Paused model rollout and placed temporary cap on new requests for affected pool.
- 18:50:00Z: Scaled up dedicated pool capacity; KV cache warmed.
- 18:55:00Z: Latency returned to SLO and error rates normalized.
```
elaine: Perfect. Jordan — did legal okay one day credit phrasing? jordan: Legal says "one day of service credit" is fine, but we should offer a simple opt-in link or reply to accept. I'll add: "Reply to this thread to opt in to the credit."
mike: Quick internal ask: please don't send the technical RCA details about KV cache internals to the customer until we finalize the engineering postmortem. High-level language is fine.
elaine: Agreed. I'll keep customer message high level and promise a detailed RCA in 3 business days. Who owns the status page update? We should reflect "resolved" and link to follow-up.
sophia: I can update status page. Proposed status update snippet:

```
Summary: Resolved. Between 18:45Z–18:55Z a model rollout caused elevated latency; we paused the rollout and added capacity. No customer data exposed. Full RCA forthcoming.
```
elaine: Ok sending to Acme in 10 minutes unless objections. Also drafting internal template for similar follow-ups. Sharing below — please comment.

```
Internal customer follow-up template:
- One-sentence impact summary
- Clear exact timeline (UTC)
- What we did to mitigate
- High-level root cause
- Customer-facing next steps + ETA for RCA
- Offered remediation (credit) and opt-in mechanism
- Owner + contact for follow-up
```
mike: Love the template. Two additions: include "did this affect any other customers?" answer and whether there is any required action from the customer.
elaine: Good call. Adding that.
elaine: Sending now. I'll post status update after customer msg goes out. mike — please assign the RCA doc to sophia + oncall for 72-hour turnaround. jordan — once we have legal-approved wording for credit, I'll send the opt-in flow.
jordan: Assigned. Also noting to keep the customer copy free of internal metrics (no 95th/99th numbers).
sophia: I'll start the RCA doc and include reproducible steps we used in the mitigation. Will attach a regression test for rollout to CI to prevent this.
elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll update thread when Acme replies. For tracking — action items:
- Sophia: RCA doc (owner) — due in 72 hrs
- Mike: Add autoscale guardrail change to infra backlog
- Jordan: Finalize credit opt-in wording
- Elaine: Send customer and status page updates

elaine: Closing loop — Acme responded with: "Thanks for the quick update. We'll opt in to the credit and would like to review the RCA when ready." I'll follow up separately to schedule a technical review. :white_check_mark:
